hero.intro: Most of my work is full-stack web development: I like taking an idea from the database to a clean, friendly interface. I also enjoy automating things with AI, and I'm learning more about cybersecurity so I can build apps that are secure from the start.

paragraphs: I'm Laura, but everyone calls me Lau. I'm finishing my degree in Software Engineering and Digital Business at ESEN, and I currently work as a full-stack software engineer, building web platforms from the backend to the interface.

I got into tech because I liked the idea of solving real problems with code, and the business side of my degree taught me to always ask who is going to use what I build. That's why I care as much about a clean interface as I do about a solid backend.
Outside of work I'm Campus Lead for Ai Labs at my university, helping organize tech events in El Salvador. I also write short threads on X explaining AI agents and security in the simplest way I can.
If you want to build something together or just talk tech, write to me.
